plain: To judge or consider something to be so.

webster.text: To think; to judge; to be of opinion; to conclude on consideration; as, he deems it prudent to be silent.

example.quote: As to this point, I think the constitution stands well, the legislature may, when it shall deem it expedient, from time to time, authorise the president alone to appoint particular inferior officers, and when necessary to take back the power.
example.cite: Letters from the Federal Farmer to the Republican, Letter XIII, Jan. 14, 1788
